text: 1353 changes row filling from synchronous index assignment to one scheduled animation frame. Accepted index setters retain only the latest _index and avoid scheduling another frame while one is pending; the callback skips detached rows. fillRow cancels a pending frame when forced immediately. Preserve the separation between index assignment and rendered content, rather than assume an index setter has finished all DOM/label work. This is static source and test-code inspection. title: Tree row index changes are coalesced until the next animation frame
